plan.frames: Poses are the TCP in the robot base frame (training model: body carrying joint_0; hardware: driver base frame). Translations are base-frame vectors. Rotations are base-frame rotation vectors applied on the left about the TCP origin (R_target = exp(r) @ R), the training apply_delta_pose convention.
plan.name: scheduled_tra_x+

units.time: s since command onset (monotonic host clock on hardware, simulated time in sim)
units.driver_tcp: m then angle-axis rad, driver base frame (driver's own FK)

end_effector.finger_offset_meaning: offset_finger_left/right are the palm-centre to carriage-centre offsets with the fingers at the closed configuration, in metres. They are not the gripper joint coordinate.

hardware_configuration.note: Read only; nothing is written. Motor PID gains are the controller's cascaded position/velocity loops in its own units; they are not MuJoCo kp/kv.

onset.definition: monotonic host time of the first loop tick; the first target is sent (Cartesian) or set and solved (external IK) in that tick

samples.note: fresh state messages only; t_s is the host time the read returned (first seen), relative to onset; tcp is training-model FK of arm_q

stop_reason: safety: TCP 31.9 mm from the held target
